card.name: Inside citation titles and names
card.fires_on: Words partway through reference-list article titles (e.g. 'Treatment of', 'Advances in') and through a person's name or title in a quote attribution, right before the next part of the title or name.

modes.label: Reference titles
modes.description: Linking words or word endings inside a cited article title in a reference list.
modes.example: Fashner J, Ericson K, Werner S. Treatment of<< the>> common cold in children and adults.

modes.label: Names in attributions
modes.description: Part of a person's first name or title inside a 'said Dr. X' attribution, before the surname.
modes.example: said Dr.<< Andrew>> Ko, a cancer researcher at the University
